title: Our Voice
slide_intent: Define both a tone and its limits so a writer can be bold without making the reader feel excluded or attacked.
strategic_value: Five bounded voice attributes can make T-Mobile’s customer-first positioning more consistent in everyday language.
demonstration: A four-column table maps human, optimistic, accessible, energetic and disruptive to explanations and positive/negative tone descriptors.
practical_value: Use each row to test whether copy expresses the intended quality without crossing its stated boundary.

content_islands.name: Voice title
content_islands.spec: Place the title in the left column.

content_islands.name: Attribute matrix
content_islands.spec: Align five rows across attribute, meaning, desired sound and excluded sound columns.

ingredient.name: Brand voice
ingredient.role: Make communication feel human, clear and purposeful.
ingredient.application: Use human, optimistic, accessible, energetic and disruptive language within the paired boundaries; for example, assertive does not mean aggressive.
ingredient.scope: Brand copy across the five attributes; these are tone criteria rather than a mandatory word list.
